title: Bought for a friend
text: Bought for a friend. She loved it. The smell was awesome. Would buy again. The lid was dented but she didn’t mind.

product_metadata.title: Happy Birthday Gifts for Men - Funny Gift for Friends Boss Neighbor Partner Brother Present Lemongrass Sage Candle
features: [PERFECT GIFT TO FEEL SPECIAL] - This candle is perfect as a gift for your best friend, forever friend, separated friend, new friend, old friend on their birthday. The gift will touch their hearts and make them feel the happiness and love that the gift is filled with.

[PLEASANT AND RELAXING GIFT] - Even without candle lit, the room is filled with a light lemongrass sage scent that will help your friends relax after a stressful holiday, reduce anxiety, improve sleep, and help relieve headaches, bringing sweetness and calm. Enjoy the day in the soft candlelight and fresh air.

[FUNNY GIFTS FOR WOMEN] - Great gift for best friend, coworker, boss, neighbor, classmate, partner, brother, sister, bestie or other anyone. Add a little humor to gift giving and make them laugh when they receive it!

[A WARM GIFT FOR ANY FRIENDS] - Made from all natural soy wax, this candle contains no harmful substances or toxic chemical residues, it burns for approximately 50 hours and burns without soot or pungent odor. It is the perfect addition to the home or office, display this candle in the office, living room, bedroom, bathroom or kitchen.

[LIGHTWEIGHT AND BEAUTIFUL GIFT] - Packed in a beautiful and sturdy box that fits easily into your gift bag, the candle measures 2.75*3.45 inches, making it a fun and memorable gift for all occasions that won't be too heavy to carry, and you can even make a perfect gift basket with it.
